page_title: WOL 0-3 NOT | Wolves v Nottingham Forest 06/01/2025, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' That's the end of the match.
90+4' 0 - 3 GOAL! Taiwo Awoniyi (Nottingham) runs onto a pass from James Ward-Prowse after great counter attacking play and hits a fine first-time shot into the net from close range. It’s now 0:3.
90' We will have 4 min. of added time.
90' Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) attempts to slip the ball through the defence, but is unable to find any of his teammates.
89' Taiwo Awoniyi (Nottingham) finds space inside the box but rifles his effort just wide of the left post.
88' Nuno Espirito Santo prepares a substitution. Chris Wood is replaced by Taiwo Awoniyi (Nottingham).
88' The substitution has been made. James Ward-Prowse (Nottingham) has replaced Morgan Gibbs-White.
88' Rodrigo Gomes (Wolves) attempts to send over a cross in order to find one of his teammates, but an opposition defender averts the danger by intercepting the effort.
85' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Wolves) goes down in the box after a challenge from the defender. Possibly unsighted, the referee just waves play on.
84' Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) swings in a cross from the corner, but Matz Sels reads it well and gathers the ball.
83' Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves) receives a good pass just outside the box, unleashes a strike from a promising position, but the shot is blocked by the defender. Wolves win a corner.
81' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Wolves) jumps into a tackle and Peter Bankes signals a foul.
79' The shots on goal statistics – 6:2.
76' The linesman signals that Mario Lemina (Wolves) is offside and the referee confirms the decision.
75' Vitor Pereira has decided to make a change. Pablo Sarabia (Wolves) replaces Goncalo Guedes.
75' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Carlos Forbs (Wolves) comes onto the pitch so that Hee-Chan Hwang can be given a rest.
72' Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) latches onto a cross but somehow sends his close-range header high over the bar.
69' The manager makes a subsitution with Ryan Yates (Nottingham) coming on for Anthony Elanga.
69' Nuno Espirito Santo decides to make a substitution. Elliot Anderson will be replaced by Jota Silva (Nottingham).
68' The goalkeeper punched the ball away after Rayan Ait-Nouri (Wolves) took the corner.

68' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Wolves) does well to control a poor pass on the edge of the box then shoots towards the right side of the goal. Matz Sels is out of position but leaps to make a brilliant save. The ball goes out of play and Wolves have been awarded a corner kick.
66' Rayan Ait-Nouri (Wolves) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out.
62' Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) launches a powerful cross from the corner into the box, but the ball is intercepted by the defender.

62' Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) expertly controls the pass inside the penalty area and shoots, but it's inadvertently blocked a defender. The referee points to the corner flag and Nottingham will take a corner.
60' The game has come to an end for Nicolas Dominguez. He has contributed as much as he could today. He will be replaced by the fresh legs of Morato (Nottingham).
59' Here is a change. Pedro Lima is going off and Vitor Pereira gives the last tactical orders to Jean-Ricner Bellegarde (Wolves).
59' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Thomas Doyle leaves the pitch and Mario Lemina (Wolves) comes on.
59' Goncalo Guedes (Wolves) brings his opponent down. Peter Bankes has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle for a foul.
57' The linesman raises his flag. Chris Wood (Nottingham) is adjudged offside.
56' Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) plays a one-two with Nicolas Dominguez, but the move breaks down.
56' 54:46 – the ratio of ball possession.
53' Rayan Ait-Nouri (Wolves) takes the corner but fails to find any of his teammates. The ball is easily cleared out of danger.
53' Matt Doherty (Wolves) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. It will be a corner kick for Wolves.
52' It looks like Rodrigo Gomes (Wolves) saw red with that tackle. Peter Bankes won't tolerate such behaviour on the pitch and blows for a foul.
50' Goncalo Guedes (Wolves) sends a long ball across the pitch, but it misses its target.
49' Neco Williams (Nottingham) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
48' Nikola Milenkovic (Nottingham) finds enough space to climb high and plants a header way over the bar. What a poor effort.
47' The linesman points to the corner flag, Nottingham are going to take it.
47' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
46' Thomas Doyle (Wolves) has tested the patience of referee Peter Bankes and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
46' The game restarts for the second half.
45+3' Peter Bankes has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+2' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) finds himself beyond the last defender, but the game is stopped by the referee after the linesman signals for offside.
45' 2 additional min. will be played.

44' 0 - 2 Callum Hudson-Odoi is in a good shooting position, but he sees his teammate and passes the ball to him. Chris Wood (Nottingham) takes it nicely and beats the goalkeeper with a precise shot into the bottom right corner to make the score 0:2.
38' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) attempts to find Anthony Elanga, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
37' Matt Doherty (Wolves) makes an overly-aggressive challenge and Peter Bankes blows his whistle for a foul.
35' Nottingham failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
35' Here comes the ref’s decision after the VAR review. It’s not penalty to Nottingham as the referee indicates there was no infringement!

34' Play continues despite the shouts by some Nottingham players for a penalty. Wait! Referee Peter Bankes interrupts the game right now and he will review that decision using VAR! Let's see what happens.
34' That looked a certain handball by Rayan Ait-Nouri (Wolves) inside the box, but the ref wasn't having it and just played on. NO penalty!
31' Rayan Ait-Nouri (Wolves) takes the corner, but one of the defenders reacts well and rises highest to head the ball away.

31' Pedro Lima (Wolves) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance. Good work from Wolves as they win a corner.
31' Matz Sels makes a superb save to deny a header which was nodded low towards the middle of the goal by Jorgen Strand Larsen (Wolves) after a cross from the side.
30' Yellow card. Nicolas Dominguez (Nottingham) goes into the book for a bad tackle on his opponent.
28' A cross into the box from Rodrigo Gomes (Wolves) is cleared.
27' The current number of shots on target for both teams is 6:4.
25' Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) receives a well-played pass inside the penalty area and shoots. His effort sails well wide of the left post.
24' Ola Aina (Nottingham) races towards goal but the defender gets back well to make a challenge.
22' Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) wastes a good opportunity as his pass into the box is blocked by the defence.
21' Nicolas Dominguez (Nottingham) receives a pass and decides to smash the ball from long range, but his poor effort sails high over the bar.
20' A promising cross into the box is nearly received by the lurking Jorgen Strand Larsen (Wolves), but one of the defending players cuts it out to avert the threat.
20' Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
19' Wolves couldn't find the way to score from a long-range free kick as Matz Sels (Nottingham) leaped high and intercepted a cross.
17' Callum Hudson-Odoi (Nottingham) appears to handle the ball in the box, but the ref turns down the penalty appeals and waves play on!
16' Peter Bankes shows a yellow card to Elliot Anderson (Nottingham) for his blatant foul.
15' Matz Sels leaps to collect the ball from the corner which was sent over by Rayan Ait-Nouri (Wolves).

15' Rodrigo Gomes (Wolves) picks up a lofted cross inside the box and fires a quick shot towards the roof of the net. His promising effort is kept out by Matz Sels, who pulls off a stunning save! The ball is out of play. Wolves win a corner kick.
14' Jorgen Strand Larsen (Wolves) picks up a pass inside the box and finds some space for a shot before unleashing a low drive goalwards, but one of the defending players blocks his effort.
13' Pedro Lima (Wolves) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked.
11' Hee-Chan Hwang (Wolves) and Goncalo Guedes attempt to exchange short two-yard passes, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball.
10' Chris Wood (Nottingham) blasts the ball high over the crossbar.
9' Anthony Elanga (Nottingham) slides a pass forward, but one of the defenders cuts it out.
7' 0 - 1 Goal! A precise cut back on the goal line from Anthony Elanga finds Morgan Gibbs-White (Nottingham) right in front of goal, and he easily buries the ball into the bottom right corner. 0:1.
5' Wolves are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
2' Joao Gomes (Wolves) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Matz Sels, who smothers the ball.
1' The first half of this match is about to start.
Murillo (Nottingham) strikes a thunderbolt from a long-range free kick, but the effort goes well wide of the left post. It's going to be a goal kick.
Nottingham will kick the game off.
Peter Bankes is the one to supervise the game today.
